Cadre 3.6.0 makes every MCP result reliably visible to coding agents, even
when their client does not expose MCP structured content directly. The 22-tool
surface, canonical project state, template set v2, and approval lifecycle are
unchanged.

## Agent-visible result contract

- Every tool response now ends with compact JSON that exactly mirrors its
  `structuredContent` value.
- Successes, structured failures, elicitation outcomes, status results,
  execution receipts, and mutation receipts all use the same fallback.
- Template and candidate bodies remain in their existing content/resource
  blocks and are not duplicated into mirrored descriptors.
- Agents can parse `proposalToken` and every other decision or recovery field
  from the final model-visible text block before making a follow-up call.

## Complete output schemas

- All 22 MCP tools publish Node-18-compatible output schemas.
- Reusable schemas cover errors, artifacts, templates, plans, status views,
  scheduler state, transitions, worktrees, and mutation receipts.
- Approval-required variants require the complete proposal and an opaque
  `proposalToken`; applied variants reject and omit proposal tokens.
- Server-side refinements enforce exact success and structured-error variants
  while the published object-root schemas advertise the stable field superset.
- The validated serialized tool-catalog ceiling is now 64 KiB to accommodate
  the output schemas.
- Zed installation safely refreshes a rotated Node executable path when the
  existing server still targets the exact managed Cadre MCP file, while
  continuing to reject foreign server targets.

## Compatibility

This is an additive transport contract release. It does not change tool names,
inputs, canonical artifact formats, proposal storage, or the immutable v2
template set. Existing 3.5.1 projects remain readable and use the normal
approved `refresh` workflow to record runtime 3.6.0 before further mutation.

## Install or upgrade

```bash
npm install -g cadre-ai@3.6.0
cadre-ai doctor
cadre-ai install --target all --scope user
```

Start a new Codex task, run `/reload-plugins` in Claude Code, and open a new
native Zed Agent thread so each client loads the new schemas and guidance.

## Verification

- Strict TypeScript check and all 59 CLI/domain/MCP integration tests.
- Validation of all 22 output schemas, exact final-text mirrors, structured
  errors, template payload discipline, and the 64 KiB catalog ceiling.
- Create, review, archive, and governed-integration apply calls using tokens
  parsed only from model-visible JSON.
- Package dry-run, static documentation build, and native installer validation
  for Codex, Claude Code, and Zed Agent.

Read the [package changelog](https://github.com/vishal-kr-barnwal/cadre/blob/release-3.6.0/harness/CHANGELOG.md) or the [full 3.5.1...3.6.0 comparison](https://github.com/vishal-kr-barnwal/cadre/compare/release-3.5.1...release-3.6.0).
